Pre-heat oven to 350F

Crust:

  • 2 cups almond flour
  • 2 tbsp butter
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/4 tsp salt

Work crust in a processor, press into pie dish. Pop crust into oven for 5 min.

Filling

  • 1 lb silken tofu
  • 1 tbsp almond butter (or other nut butter)
  • 3 tbsp lime juice
  • 2 tsp lime zest
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1 cup sugar equivalent of stevia or sweetener of your choice.
  • 1-2 scoops vanilla whey protein powder
  • 1 tbsp vanilla extract
  • 1/4 tsp xanthan gum
  • 1 tbsp cornstarch dissolved in 1-2 tbsp of water

Add the cornstarch and xanthan gum last. Immediately blend ingredients in a food processor until incorporated. Pour into pie crush, pop in oven for 40-45m.

Remove from oven, place in fridge for 1-2 hours, or until set up and firm.

For berry pie, cut back on the tofu, and add berries. I did straw berries. Substitute by weight.
